description: This file defines the AiLog interface and related functions for JSON serialization/deserialization, representing AI log entries in the application. It includes properties like aiProvider, function name, credit costs, tokens, timestamps, and creator info.

methods.name: instanceOfAiLog
methods.description: Type guard function to check if an object implements the AiLog interface.

methods.name: AiLogFromJSON
methods.description: Creates an AiLog object from a JSON input.

methods.name: AiLogFromJSONTyped
methods.description: Creates an AiLog object from JSON with optional discriminator handling.

methods.name: AiLogToJSON
methods.description: Serializes an AiLog object to JSON format.
